Setting up: digits a, b with a + b = 13 and (10a + b) − (10b + a) = 9(a − b) = ±27, so a − b = ±3.

Then a + b = 13 and a − b = 3 give a = 8, b = 5, so the number is 85 and its reversal is 58. Check: 85 − 58 = 27 and 8 + 5 = 13. ✓.

The case a − b = −3 gives a = 5, b = 8, so the number is 58 and its reversal is 85. That gives a difference of −27, which does not match "difference is 27" under the original-minus-reversed reading. Either way, the sum is 85 + 58 = 143.

The correct answer is 143.
